source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Classify a disease as communicable, non-communicable, or chronic from its cause, spread, and duration.
node_labels: Living systems: organisms, health and ecosystems

intelligence.enrichment: Communicable diseases are caused by pathogens and can spread; non-communicable diseases are not caused by pathogens and do not spread from one person to another; chronic diseases persist for a long time, more than 3 months. Pathogen cause and person-to-person spread point to communicable disease; lifestyle, diet, or environment links without person-to-person spread point to non-communicable disease; long duration points to chronic disease. The learner correctly applies this rule: Communicable diseases are caused by pathogens and can spread; non-communicable diseases are not caused by pathogens and do not spread from one person to another; chronic diseases persist for a long time, more than 3 months. Any serious or long-lasting disease must be communicable, and any disease with a germ word must be non-communicable because germs are inside the body.
